newsitem.title: UK: Cazenove Indian GDR Index down 0.88 percent.
newsitem.headline: Cazenove Indian GDR Index down 0.88 percent.

text.p: The Cazenove Indian GDR Index fell 0.66 points, 0.88 percent, to 76.17 points after the Bombay Stock Exchange 30 share index rose 12.07 points to a provisional 3,264.38.
The premium for GDRs over stocks on the local market was 18.17 percent.
The Cazenove index is a capitalisation weighted basket of Indian global depositary receipts and measures the change from midday on the previous trading day to midday today.
